name: Ichthammol (ammonium bituminosulfonate)
className: Topical bacteriostatic agent for eczema (acts like coal tar)

formulations.label: Ointment 10%
formulations.strengths: Ichthammol 10% (clinic product). UK product used: ichthammol 10% w/w in glycerol
formulations.note: No UK SmPC for an ichthammol ointment was found. The only UK single-ingredient product is ichthammol 10% w/w in glycerol (a viscous liquid for chronic eczema). The information below comes from that product's SPC; the clinic ointment base differs.

src.q: Ichthammol BPC 1973 10.0% w/w
Topical bacteriostatic moisturiser Viscous black liquid

formulations.label: Shampoo
formulations.strengths: Ichthammol (clinic product; strength not given). UK product used: ichthammol 10% w/w in glycerol
formulations.note: No UK SmPC for an ichthammol shampoo was found. The UK ichthammol 10% w/w in glycerol SPC (a liquid applied to the skin for chronic eczema) is the only UK single-ingredient product. Its dose (1 to 3 times daily) is not applied to the shampoo; follow the clinic product's own directions. Its contraindication, cautions, pregnancy and breastfeeding statements are shown because the active substance is the same.
